population: Matched task IDs in current repository reports; primary outcomes only.
CI: 10,000 paired instance percentile-bootstrap resamples; sorted instance IDs; numpy.default_rng(20261110), reset for each comparison; batches of 500.
p: Two-sided exact McNemar test on discordant task pairs.
direction: first system minus second system in percentage points.
HapRepair_exception: Separate results in ../haprepair/ use file-snapshot clusters, 20,000 bootstrap draws and 20,000 cluster sign flips, seed 20261117.
controlled_matching: This directory does not recompute controlled offline matcher statistics.
PAR: Per-instance PAR columns are omitted from distribution; no applicability labels, outcome labels or statistical results are changed.
prior_method_reference: recompute_v5.py, stat function; the method is reused with current repository inputs, not its old input paths.
failure_level_fields: Failure-level columns are not distributed. SPR, bootstrap CIs, and paired tests read binary result fields and task/group identifiers only.
